title: Wide & Deep Learning for Recommender Systems
summary: Wide & Deep learning jointly trains a wide linear model for memorisation and a deep neural network for generalisation. It was deployed in Google Play app recommendations and improved app acquisition in online experiments. The paper remains a standard starting point for industrial recommender and ads ranking systems.

title: DeepFM: A Factorization-Machine based Neural Network for CTR Prediction
summary: DeepFM combines factorisation machines with deep neural networks to learn both low- and high-order feature interactions for click-through-rate prediction. It needs no manual feature engineering and outperformed logistic regression, FM, and other deep models on Criteo and MovieLens data. It is widely used as a baseline for ads CTR modelling.

title: Deep Neural Networks for YouTube Recommendations
summary: YouTube's recommendation system uses deep candidate generation followed by a deep ranking network, learning from user watch history, search, and context. The two-stage design scales to billions of videos and users while personalising recommendations. It is one of the most-cited descriptions of a production recommender system.
